# Newgreen Technology (Ningbo Newgreen Technology Co., Ltd.)

> Ningbo Newgreen Technology Co., Ltd. is an Alibaba onsite-verified manufacturer and exporter of photovoltaic roof hooks, solar mounting systems, stainless-steel meat hooks, manhole covers and custom stamped metal parts — shipping factory-direct from Ningbo, China to Europe and the Americas.

Key facts:
- Business type: Manufacturer & Trading Company
- Founded: 2022 · Based in Ningbo, Zhejiang, China
- Main markets: Western Europe, Northern Europe, Eastern Europe, North America, Central America, Southeast Asia
- Credentials: ISO 9001 quality management, Alibaba.com Onsite-Check Verified, RoHS / CE on selected product lines
- Sales contact: info@nbnewgreen.com
- Catalog size: 59 products in 6 categories
- Alibaba storefront: https://nbnewgreen.en.alibaba.com

## Products

- [Solar Roof Hooks](https://www.nbnewgreen.com/products/#solar-roof-hooks): Fixed and adjustable hooks that anchor photovoltaic rail systems to pitched tile roofs — in hot-dip galvanized steel, zinc-aluminum-magnesium alloy and stainless steel. (5 products)
- [Solar Mounting Systems](https://www.nbnewgreen.com/products/#solar-mounting-systems): Aluminum and coated-steel bracket systems for rooftop, flat-roof, carport and ground-mounted photovoltaic arrays, supplied as kits under the NG brand. (13 products)
- [Stainless Meat Hooks](https://www.nbnewgreen.com/products/#meat-hooks): Food-grade stainless hooks for slaughter lines, refrigerated transport, butcheries and home curing — including Euro patterns and the DIN 5047 standard. (10 products)
- [Manhole Covers](https://www.nbnewgreen.com/products/#manhole-covers): Fabricated stainless-steel manhole covers — recessed "invisible", circular and fully custom formats straight from our sheet-metal shop, from 2 pieces. (4 products)
- [Metal Stamping & OEM Parts](https://www.nbnewgreen.com/products/#metal-stamping): OEM stamping, laser cutting, bending, welding and tapping: washers, gaskets, PV grounding hardware, springs, stair treads and made-to-print parts. (23 products)
- [Shelving & Storage Equipment](https://www.nbnewgreen.com/products/#shelving): Stainless shelving, heavy-duty racks, beam-type units and steel mesh turnover boxes — storage hardware for kitchens, warehouses, cold rooms and factory logistics. (4 products)

# Full product catalog


## Category: Solar Roof Hooks

Fixed and adjustable hooks that anchor photovoltaic rail systems to pitched tile roofs — in hot-dip galvanized steel, zinc-aluminum-magnesium alloy and stainless steel.


### Adjustable Solar Roof Hook, Hot-Dip Galvanized Q235

- URL: https://www.nbnewgreen.com/products/dual-adjustable-galvanized-solar-roof-hook/
- Category: Solar Roof Hooks
- Indicative price: US$ 0.8 / piece (FOB, varies with quantity/spec)
- MOQ: 1,000 pieces
- Summary: Dual- and single-adjustable fixed hooks for pitched tile roofs, stamped from Q235 steel and hot-dip galvanized for long outdoor service.

These MAYS-brand roof hooks anchor photovoltaic rail systems to tile roofs. Available in dual-adjustable and single-adjustable versions, they let installers fine-tune height and lateral position to compensate for uneven battens and varying tile profiles — without bending metal on the roof.

Each hook is stamped from Q235 structural carbon steel and finished with hot-dip galvanizing, the protection class used for outdoor power infrastructure: the zinc layer keeps protecting the base steel even where the coating is scratched during installation. Slotted mounting holes give positioning play when fixing to rafters and rails.

Key features:
- Dual-adjustable and single-adjustable versions in one series
- Hot-dip galvanized coating over Q235 carbon steel
- Slotted holes for height and side-to-side alignment
- Designed for tile-roof photovoltaic rail systems
- OEM branding and packaging available

Specifications:
- Brand: MAYS
- Material: Q235 structural carbon steel
- Surface treatment: Hot-dip galvanized
- Adjustability: Dual-adjustable or single-adjustable
- Application: Tile-roof photovoltaic mounting

- URL: https://www.nbnewgreen.com/products/galvanized-tile-roof-solar-hook/

Hot-dip galvanizing gives the steel a metallurgically bonded zinc layer suited to decades of rooftop exposure. The series is a staple order for solar distributors and EPC installers, and can be produced under your own brand and packaging as an OEM program.

Key features:

### Zn-Al-Mg Alloy Tile Roof Solar Hook

- URL: https://www.nbnewgreen.com/products/zn-al-mg-tile-roof-solar-hook/
- Category: Solar Roof Hooks
- Indicative price: US$ 1.05 / piece (FOB, varies with quantity/spec)
- MOQ: 1,000 pieces
- Summary: Tile-roof solar hook formed from hot-dip zinc-aluminum-magnesium coated steel, whose self-healing cut-edge protection outperforms conventional galvanizing.

This roof hook is made from steel with a hot-dip zinc-aluminum-magnesium (Zn-Al-Mg) coating — the corrosion system increasingly specified for solar structures because its protective layer re-forms over cut edges and scratches, where ordinary galvanized parts start rusting first.

That makes the hook a strong choice for coastal, humid and high-rainfall markets. It installs like a conventional tile-roof hook, carrying the mounting rail clear of the tile course while fastening to the roof structure below.

Key features:
- Hot-dip Zn-Al-Mg coating with self-healing cut-edge protection
- Well suited to coastal and high-humidity climates
- Standard tile-roof installation pattern
- Distributor-friendly bulk packaging

Specifications:
- Material: Zinc-aluminum-magnesium coated steel (hot-dip)
- Type: Tile-roof solar mounting hook
- Application: Pitched tile roofs, PV bracket systems

- Indicative price: US$ 1.9–2.5 / piece (FOB, varies with quantity/spec)

Our premium tile-roof mounting hook is formed from stainless steel — SUS 304 where maximum corrosion resistance is required, or SS430 as an economical alternative — and finished by shot blasting for a uniform matte surface free of scale and burrs.

Because it is produced in our own fabrication shop, the geometry can be customized to your drawings: base-plate hole patterns, riser height and hook profile are all adjustable as a custom fabrication service, with a 100-piece minimum that suits project-based buying.

### Zn-Al-Mg High-Strength Solar Mounting Bracket (NG 260526-6)

- URL: https://www.nbnewgreen.com/products/zn-al-mg-solar-mounting-bracket/

Model NG 260526-6 uses zinc-aluminum-magnesium coated steel to combine the strength of a steel section with corrosion protection that goes beyond conventional galvanizing: the Zn-Al-Mg layer forms protective products that migrate over cut edges, drill points and scratches.

The result is a high-strength PV panel support that holds its integrity in coastal and industrial atmospheres — the environments that age ordinary coated brackets fastest — while staying cost-competitive against stainless alternatives.

Key features:

- Strong fit for coastal and industrial atmospheres
- Cost-effective alternative to stainless steel

### Adjustable C-Channel Steel Solar Bracket, Zn-Al-Mg

- URL: https://www.nbnewgreen.com/products/adjustable-c-channel-solar-bracket/
- Category: Solar Mounting Systems
- Indicative price: US$ 0.5–1.6 / piece (FOB, varies with quantity/spec)
- MOQ: 1,000 pieces
- Summary: Adjustable C-type steel solar brackets in hot-dip zinc and zinc-aluminum-magnesium coatings — steel-section strength with slide-in adjustability.

C-channel (C-type) steel is the workhorse section of ground-mount and industrial solar structures: strong in bending, easy to bolt, and adjustable anywhere along the channel. This line supplies adjustable C-channel brackets in hot-dip zinc or zinc-aluminum-magnesium coated steel.

Choose conventional hot-dip galvanizing for standard atmospheres or Zn-Al-Mg for coastal and high-humidity sites where cut-edge corrosion decides service life. Both run on the same channel dimensions, so the upgrade is a coating decision, not a redesign.

Key features:
- C-type steel channel, slide-in adjustability
- Hot-dip zinc or Zn-Al-Mg coating options
- Steel-section strength for demanding spans
- Same dimensions across coating options

Specifications:
- Material: C-type steel — hot-dip zinc or Zn-Al-Mg coated
- Type: Adjustable channel bracket
- Application: Ground-mount and industrial PV structures

They are stamped from 304 stainless and supplied untreated: the material itself is corrosion-proof, and bare metal teeth grip better than coated ones. Stocked in common sizes; non-standard patterns to drawing.

- Internal-tooth and external-tooth patterns

- 304 stainless, no coating to flake or wear
